acceptanceCriteria: A document with accepted status only in backtick or tilde fenced examples remains nonbinding.
An actual top-level accepted status outside examples still yields accepted-spec.
An example before a genuine proposed status cannot override the genuine status.
Existing accepted FPK-V0-029 field forms retain behavior.
body:
Comprehensive expert audit 2026-09-26, finding ARCH-01. Source commit 2961076fc0b78bfab743578f2ef5c17006be058a.

A tracked docs/specs document with no document acceptance contains a fenced YAML example with column-zero Status: accepted. documentRecord treats that example as the document status; documentAuthority emits accepted-spec and authoritative confidence. This invents acceptance from instructional/example content and can prioritize the draft alongside accepted governance.

Evidence: internal/contextindex/parse.go:247; internal/contextindex/impact.go:485; internal/contextindex/parse_test.go:94

Verification: {"status": "actual", "binary": "/tmp/corvint-audit-20260926/corvint", "sourceRevision": "2961076fc0b78bfab743578f2ef5c17006be058a", "command": "corvint --root /tmp/corvint-audit-20260926/architecture-fixture context authority pkg/a.go", "receipt": "/tmp/corvint-audit-20260926/architecture-reproduction-two.json", "observed": "docs/specs/draft.md returns status accepted, authority accepted-spec, confidence authoritative; its only acceptance token is inside a fenced YAML example. Exit 0.", "unitTests": "NOT_RUN; end-to-end scratch reproduction executed instead."}

Suggested correction: Extract document-owned status fields with explicit Markdown context; at minimum exclude fenced examples. Preserve the accepted field spellings and fail conservatively when actual metadata is absent or ambiguous. Do not infer acceptance from arbitrary embedded content.

Report: .agent-evidence/2026-09-26-comprehensive-audit.md. Run focused regression tests and owning documentation checks; full repository gate only when required by governing release policy. This ticket is not implementation or acceptance evidence.
title: Example metadata can promote an unaccepted document to authoritative accepted-spec
